extension.summary: Phone and browser remote for Marantz / Denon AV receivers
extension.description: Runs a small web remote for a Marantz (or Denon) AV receiver on your network. Open http://<kodi-address>:9000/ on a phone to control power, master volume, mute, input, channel levels, sound mode, Audyssey and dynamic settings, and the front display. The add-on keeps a network (telnet) connection to the receiver, so changes made on the receiver or its own remote show up on the page straight away. Set the receiver's IP address in the add-on settings or on the page.
extension.disclaimer: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Marantz, Denon or Sound United. The web remote has no password: anyone on your local network who can open the page can control the receiver.
extension.news: v1.0.0 - First release as a standalone add-on (previously run as service.autoexec) - Settings in Kodi: AVR address, maximum volume, volume display scale, web and WebSocket ports - Reconnects to the AVR automatically and shuts down cleanly with Kodi - Shows the AVR's own input names and hides unused inputs
